newsitem.title: USA: U.S. sells 1.9 mln barrels oil in SPR sale round 2.
newsitem.headline: U.S. sells 1.9 mln barrels oil in SPR sale round 2.

text.p: The U.S. government on Thursday sold 1.9 million barrels of crude from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve for $39.6 million in the second round of its ongoing auction, the Energy Department said.
Coastal Corp's Coastal States Trading took 1.5 million barrels, with Texaco Trading taking the rest.
Coastal won one 900,000 barrel tanker load at $20.95 per barrel for December delivery, and a second tanker of 600,000 barrels at $20.70 for December or January delivery.
Texaco Trading won two batches of 200,000 barrels each at $20.82 and $20.57 per barrel by pipeline in November.
The ongoing sale was required by Congress to raise $220 million to help trim the budget deficit.
With this week's awards, the government has reached one third of its target, having raised $33 million last week with the sale of 1.1 million barrels of sour crude and 370,000 barrels of sweet crude.
